title_en: Anthropomorphism According to Ibn Taymiyya and His Followers (Part 8)
description_en: Anthropomorphism according to Ibn Taymiyya and his followers, Part (8). The program 'Divine Unity' (Tawhid) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: Part eight examining and critiquing anthropomorphic concepts in the teachings of Ibn Taymiyya and his followers.
